steps.text: Drink from the bottle on the beach of Dognose Island.
Speak to the Crab on the beach.
Collect all the shells on the island and give them to the crab.
Pick up the big fishing net on the beach.
Fish the floatsam on the edge of the beach to get a sea-soaked bowstring, battered barrel, and weathered rosewood plank.
Use the weathered rosewood plank on the sea-soaked bowstring to make instrument. Give the instrument to the crab.
During the conversation with the crab, name the instrument and show the crab how to play it. The Crab will then tell you to find the other ceremonial leaders by investigating trees and bushes.

On the island, investigate all the trees and bushes. If the Crab is too scared to come out, perform the Sit down emote and wait a short period of time for them to come out. Speak to each Crab after they come out.
For the crab who quizzes you on the ceremony after popping out of his tree, the answers are 2, 3, 1, 4.
Once you have investigated all the trees and plants, return to the Crab on the beach with the instrument and choose the option to wait for the others leads to turn up.
Continue through the dialog and ceremony cutscenes.
